title: pseudacoridium cootesii

It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and prevent the development of atherosclerosis, thanks to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
